patch.summary: Grafana Cloud cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Grafana Cloud pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Grafana Cloud plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: Grafana Cloud cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Grafana Cloud against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise security and SSO (Free, Pro (platform fee), Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, infrastructure monitoring, APM and distributed tracing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Pro bills many usage dimensions — the list price fee is not the bill. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

blocks.title: Grafana Cloud cost mistakes to avoid

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Pro bills many usage dimensions — the list price fee is not the bill

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Free retention is 14 days — production teams usually need Pro

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Enterprise security (SAML, audit) is not the Free/Pro default story

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Running Grafana OSS yourself is a different TCO (people, not SaaS)
